name: ffmpeg
description: FFmpeg — führendes Open-Source-Multimedia-Framework (LGPL/GPL). CLI-Tools: ffmpeg (konvertieren/filtern/streamen), ffprobe (analysieren), ffplay (abspielen). Bibliotheken: libavcodec, libavformat, libavfilter, libavutil, libavdevice, libswresample, libswscale. Hunderte Codecs/Container/Filter. Python-Integration via subprocess, python-ffmpeg oder ffmpeg-python.
author: FFmpeg Project (Open Source)
covers: Video-Codecs: libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9, libaom-av1, prores_ks, dnxhd
Audio-Codecs: aac, libmp3lame, libopus, flac, pcm_s16le
Video-Filter: scale, crop, pad, rotate, transpose, hflip, overlay, drawtext, thumbnail, yadif, nlmeans, eq
Audio-Filter: loudnorm, volume, afade, atempo, equalizer, anlmdn, pan, aresample
Complex Filtergraph: hstack, vstack, overlay, split, concat, amix
Streaming: RTMP, HLS, UDP, WebRTC-Input, Screen-Capture
Python-Integration: subprocess mit List-Args, python-ffmpeg (typed), ffmpeg-python
libavcodec, libavformat, libavfilter, libavutil, libavdevice, libswresample, libswscale
